scope: Observed unchanged main tables/functions, isolated VM with save/UI stubs. Calendar earnings assume stated completion; not measured player pacing, full engine, UI, migration or Android acceptance.

shop.name: Auto-Ascend Ritual
shop.desc: Choose which Rift to defeat before automatic Ascension. Toggle it on or off anytime. Your chosen target persists across Ascensions.

shop.name: Extended Rest
shop.desc: Raise the offline earnings cap from 12 hours to 24 hours.

shop.name: Deep Rest
shop.desc: Raise the offline earnings cap by another 24 hours, stacking with Extended Rest.

shop.name: Loadout Memory
shop.desc: The Rift Forge remembers your last bulk-buy multiplier between visits, instead of resetting to 1x.

currencyMatrix.name: Battle Focus
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% Lumen from every kill, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Shard Sense
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% Shards from every kill, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Formation Training
currencyMatrix.effect: +5% passive Wisp damage per level; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.

currencyMatrix.name: Guardian's Resolve
currencyMatrix.effect: +10% tap damage, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Swift Recovery
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% faster Wisp ability charge, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Arcane Calibration
currencyMatrix.effect: +3 percentage points to the damaging Wisp ability factor per level. Burst, Breaker, Gale and Thorn only; no passive or Tap bonus.

currencyMatrix.name: Resource Conduction
currencyMatrix.effect: +4 percentage points to the ability resource factor per level. Gale Shards and Thorn Lumen only; rounded per cast, not kill rewards.

currencyMatrix.name: Luminous Tracking
currencyMatrix.effect: +0.5 percentage points Luminous chance per level for future eligible encounters; total chance at most 35%. No extra Motes per kill.

currencyMatrix.name: Starlight Affinity
currencyMatrix.effect: +10% Lumen from every kill, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Steady Hands
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% tap damage, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Echoing Rest
currencyMatrix.effect: +5% offline earning rate, per level (caps at 100%).

currencyMatrix.name: Cheaper Bonds
currencyMatrix.effect: −3% Wisp recruiting cost, per level (floor 40%).

currencyMatrix.name: Swift Ascension
currencyMatrix.effect: +4% Prisms earned per Ascend, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Eternal Momentum
currencyMatrix.effect: +6% passive Wisp damage per level; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.

currencyMatrix.name: Deep Reserves
currencyMatrix.effect: +2 hours to your offline cap, per level.

currencyMatrix.name: Wisp Ascendancy
currencyMatrix.effect: +15% passive Wisp damage permanently; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.

currencyMatrix.name: Guardian's Mastery
currencyMatrix.effect: +20% tap damage, permanently.

currencyMatrix.name: Rift Attunement
currencyMatrix.effect: +10% offline earning rate, permanently (stacks past 100%).

currencyMatrix.name: Shard Attunement
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% Shards earned per kill, permanently.

currencyMatrix.name: Lumen Wellspring
currencyMatrix.effect: +8% Lumen earned per kill, permanently.

currencyMatrix.name: Formation Insight
currencyMatrix.effect: +5% passive Wisp damage permanently; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.

currencyMatrix.name: Luminous Sense
currencyMatrix.effect: +10% Motes gained from Luminous enemies, permanently.

currencyMatrix.name: Ascendant Clarity
currencyMatrix.effect: +5% Prisms earned per Ascend, permanently.

currencyMatrix.name: Measured Inquiry
currencyMatrix.effect: 2% less work per completed level, up to 20%, for future starts of Wisp Ascendancy, Guardian’s Mastery, Rift Attunement, Shard Attunement, Lumen Wellspring, Formation Insight, Luminous Sense and Ascendant Clarity. Running Studies and Measured Inquiry itself are unchanged.
